title: Mathematical Graph Core: Storage, Views, Errors for NetworkX Parity
description: Wave 1 (Foundation) of the NetworkX-3.6.1-parity effort for mathematical/* crates. Expand mathematical_graph (mathematical/graph/rs/lib.rs, currently 1021 lines) by ADDING new regions, purely additive — do not touch the existing `pub mod algorithms` block, Kinds, or PropertyJson regions (other crates depend on them; migration happens in a later wave). Add: (1) Storage<P: PortModel, D: Directedness> — shared adjacency-map storage (BTreeMap-based nodes/edges/adjacency/predecessors, monotone id allocators, graph-level PropertyBag, full CRUD with upsert-vs-parallel-edge semantics per PortModel, cascading remove_node); add `const MULTI_EDGES: bool` to PortModel. (2) GraphView/AttrView/EdgeWeights traits — the generic interface all future algorithm crates will be written against (UnitWeight, AttrWeight, blanket closure impl). (3) Csr — frozen index-based snapshot (from_view constructor, out/in neighbor + edge-id arrays, NodeId<->usize maps). (4) Read-only borrowed Views (SubgraphView, EdgeSubgraphView, ReversedView, FilteredView, UndirectedView) implementing GraphView generically over &impl GraphView. (5) Interner<L> — generalized bidirectional label<->NodeId map (existing string-only IdIndex stays untouched). (6) GraphError — flat enum mirroring NetworkX's exception hierarchy, with Display+Error impls. (7) Utils — MappedHeap decrease-key priority queue, pairwise/arbitrary_element free functions, TOL_STRICT/TOL_LOOSE constants. Ownership: I own exactly mathematical/graph/rs/lib.rs and nothing else (no Cargo.toml, launch.json, project.json, script.ts, or other crates' lib.rs). Verification gates: cargo build/test/clippy -p mathematical_graph, SEMIO_TEST_LEVEL=quick cargo test -p mathematical_graph, bun ./script.ts test in mathematical/graph, plus a no-op consumer check building mathematical_graph_dsl, mathematical_graph_drawing, infinite_board to confirm nothing broke.
